Source: There are few population-wide data on viral suppression (VS) that can be used to monitor programmatic targets in sub-Saharan Africa.

Yoruba: Dáta péréte ló wà lárọ̀ọ́ọ́tó àwọn ènìyàn lórí i viral suppression (VS) tí a lè fi mójú tó àwọn agbàtọ́jú ní agbẹ̀gbe Gúúsù ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà.

Hausa: Akwai ‘yan bayanai kaɗan game wakilta-daidai a kan danniyar ƙwayoyin cuta (VS) waɗanda za a iya amfani da su don sa-ido a kan mutane masu karɓar jiyya a yankin Kudu da Hamadar Sahara ta Afrika.
Northern Sotho: Go na le datha ye mmalwa ye e akaretšago setšhaba mabapi le kgatelelo ya baerase (VS) yeo e ka šomišwago go lekola tšeo di nepilwego ke mananeo go dinaga tša borwa bja Afrika.

Source: We describe how routinely collected viral load (VL) data from antiretroviral therapy (ART) programmes can be extrapolated to estimate population VS and validate this using a combination of empiric and model-based estimates.
Luganda: Tunnyonnyola engeri obubaka obukwata ku bungi bw’akawuka ka mukeenenya (VL) obukuŋŋaanyizibwa buli kadde okuva mu nteekateeka z’okujjanjaba obulwadde bwa mukeenenya (ART) gye busobola okunaanuulwamu okusobola okuteebereza VS mu bantu n’okukakasa kino nga tukozesa ebiteeberezo okuva mu byekalirizo awamu n’ebyo ebyesigama ku mitetenkanyirizo.
Yoruba: A ṣàpèjúwe ìgbàálẹ̀ ìṣirò àmuye dátà fáírọ́ọ̀sì láti èto antiretroviral therapy (ART) lè di lílò láti ṣe àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ ọjọ́ọwájúu ìgbéléwọ̀n ìṣirò iye ènìyàn VS àti ṣàrídájú lílo àpapọ̀ ìṣàyẹ̀wò àti ìgùnlé gbèdéke ìṣirò.
Zulu: Sichaza ukuthi ingcobelelo yesibalo sezinhlayiya (VL) eqoqwe ngokwenhlalayenza evela ezinhlelweni zokwelashwa ngezidambisigciwane (ART) ingahlanjiselwa kanjani ukuze kulinganiselwe i-VS kubantu kanye nokuqinisekisa lokhu kusetshenziswa inhlanganisela yezilinganiso ezisekelwe ngokwengcobelelo nakumamodeli.
Hausa: Mun bayyana yadda za a iya fitar da bayanan da ake tattarawa akai-akai na yawan ƙwayoyin cuta a mutum (VL) daga shirye-shiryen magungunan ƙanjamau (ART) don ƙididdige yawan VS da kuma inganta wannan ta amfani da haɗe-haɗe na ƙiyasin ƙididdiga da kuma tushen-samfuri.
Northern Sotho: Re hlaloša ka moo datha ya kelo ya bogolo bja baerase (VL) ye e kgobokeditšwego e sego ka peakanyo go mananeo a kalafi ya antiretherobaerale (ART) e ka dirišwago go akanya VS ya badudi le go tiišetša se go šomišwa dikakanyo tše bohlokwa le tšeo di theilwego godimo ga mmotlolo.

Source: The researchers' new model showed that the Western Cape's treatment for HIV is effective.

Source: The model can be a powerful tool to plan future efforts to eliminate HIV.
Luganda: Omutetenkanyirizo gusobola okuba ekikozeso eky’amaanyi eky’okuteekateeka kaweefube agenderera okumalawo HIV mu biseera ebijja.
Yoruba: Módẹ́ẹ̀lì nnáà lẹ̀ jẹ́ irinṣẹ́ tó lágbára láti ṣètò ọjọ́ iwájú láti dẹ́kun HIV.
Zulu: Imodeli ingaba yithuluzi elinamandla lokuhlela imizamo yesikhathi esizayo yokuchitha i-HIV.

Amharic: ሞዴሉ ኤችአይቪን ለማጥፋት የወደፊት ጥረቶችን ለማቀድ ሃያል መሳሪያ ሊሆን ይችላል፡፡

Source: For instance, the model predicted that we must focus on men and people under 24, especially young children, because the current treatment system does not seem to be as effective for them as for others.
Luganda: Okugeza, omutetenkanyirizo gwateebereza nti tulina kutunuulira baami n’abantu abali wansi w’emyaka 24, naddala abaana abato, kubanga omuyungo gw’enzijanjaba oguliwo gulabika okuba nga tegubatuukirako bulungi ng’abalala.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, módẹ́ẹ̀lì náà ṣàsọtẹ́lẹ̀ pé a gbọdọ̀ ṣe àfojúsùn fún àwọn okùnrin àti àwọn ẹni tójọ́ orí wọn ò ju 24 lọ, pàápàá àwọn ọmọdé, nítorí ìlàna ìtọ́jú tuntun kò jọ bí ẹni pé ó ń ṣiṣ́ẹ fún wọn bó ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́ fún àwọn ẹlòmiíràn.
Zulu: Isibonelo, imodeli yabikezela ukuthi kufanele sigxile emadodeni nakubantu abangaphansi kweminyaka engama-24, ikakhulukazi izingane ezincane, ngoba uhlelo lwamanje lokwelapha alubonakali lusebenza kahle kubo njengakwabanye.
Hausa: Alal misali, samfurin ya yi hasashen cewa dole ne mu mayar da hankali ga maza da mutanen da suke ƙasa da shekaru 24, musamman yara ƙanana, saboda tsarin jiyya na yanzu bai nuna ya yi tasiri a gare su kamar sauran ba.
Northern Sotho: Mohlala, mmotlolo o akantše gore re swanetše go bea šedi go banna le batho ba mengwaga ya ka fase ga ye 24, kudukudu bana, ka gore lenaneo la bjale la kalafo ga le bonale le ba šomela go kgotsofatša go swana le ba bangwe.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ ሞዴሉ በወንዶች እና ከ24 አመት በታች በሆኑ ሰዎች በተለይም በትናንሽ ልጆች ላይ ማተኮር እንዳለብን ተንብዯል፤ ምክንያቱም የአሁኑ የህክምና ስርአት ለሌሎች እንደሆነው ለእነርሱ ውጤታማ አይመስልም፡፡

Source: The model seems accurate for the Western Cape because the results are similar to other studies and surveys.
Luganda: Omutetenkanyirizo gulabika okuba nga gutuukiridde eri Western Cape kubanga ebyazuulibwa bifaanagana n’ebyo ebyazuulibwa mu kunoonyereza okulala awamu n’okunoonyereza keeroboza okukoleddwa.

Zulu: Imodeli ibonakala inemba eNtshonalanga Kapa ngoba imiphumela iyafana nezinye izincwaningo nama-survey.
Hausa: Samfurin ya nuna alama daidai ga Western Cape saboda sakamakon yana kama da sauran nazari da kuma bincike.
Northern Sotho: Mmotlolo o bonala o nepagetše go Kapa Bodikela ka baka la gore dipoelo di swana le tša dinyakišišo le diphatišišo tše dingwe.
Amharic: ሞዴሉ ለምእራባዊ ኬፕ ትክክለኛ ይመስላል፤ ምክንያቱም ውጤቶቹ ከሌሎች ጥናቶች እና የዳሰሳ ጥናቶች ጋር ተመሳሳይ ናቸው፡፡

Source: However, future studies should focus on adapting the model for more areas.
Luganda: Wabula, okunoonyereza okunaakolebwa mu biseera ebijja kusaanye kusse essira ku kulongoosa omutetenkanyirizo gubeere nga gutuukira ku bifo ebirala.
Yoruba: Wàyí o, àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ọjọ́ iwájú gbọ́dọ̀ gbájú mọ́ ìdàpọ módẹ́ẹ̀lì náà sí àwọn agbègbè mìíràn.

Hausa: Ko ta yaya, binciken nan gaba yakamata ya mayar da hankali a kan amfani da samfurin a ƙarin yankuna.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, dinyakišišo tša ka moso di swanetše go bea šedi go tšhomišo ya mmotlolo go ditikologo tše ntši.
Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ ወደፊት የሚደረጉ ጥናቶች ሞዴሉን ለተጨማሪ አካባቢዎች ጥቅም ላይ ማዋል ላይ ማተኮር አለባቸው፡፡

Source: This work by South African and Swiss researchers is important because record-keeping systems in Africa are often neglected and incomplete because of the many burdens it faces.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno okwakolebwa abanoonyereza okuva mu ggwanga lya South Afirika ne Buswedi kwa mugaso kubanga emiyungo egikuuma obubaka tegitera kufiibwako ate era ne gisigala nga tegituuse olw’emitawaana emingi gye giyitamu.

Zulu: Lo msebenzi wabacwaningi baseNingizimu Afrika nabaseSwitzerland ubalulekile ngoba izinhlelo zokugcina amarekhodi e-Afrika zivame ukunganakwa futhi aziphelele ngenxa yemithwalo eminingi ebhekene nayo.
